fullPassage: In 1991, the Flemish cultural entrepreneur Gerard Mortier became artistic director of the traditional Salzburger Festspiele in Austria with its mainly conservative content and background. Mozart has always been the most important artist of this world-famous festival. Mortier has been trying to innovate the festival by introducing modern artists like the stage producer and theatre maker Peter Sellars, singer David Bowie and film-maker Peter Greenaway. Mortier bases his programme on four categories: 1. Mozart's music, 2. classical music of the 20th century, 3. new music theatre events by modern artists, 4. a mixture of film and pop music culture. This programme is motivated by the need for a young audience and critical discussion about societal phenomena such as pop music and spirituality. The risky character of his artistic strategy is constantly being criticized by the Viennese elite and local Salzburg shopkeepers. However, fundamentally Mortier knows exactly how to retain the balance between tradition and innovation, which guarantees the continuity of this festival.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) traditional(전통적인), (B) conservative(보수적인), (C) innovate(혁신하다) — 원문 일치
det.analysis:
✅ ① traditional — conservative — innovate: 원문 그대로
❌ ② modern — conservative — innovate: modern은 traditional의 반의어
❌ ③ traditional — progressive — innovate: progressive는 conservative의 반의어
❌ ④ traditional — conservative — preserve: preserve는 innovate의 반의 뉘앙스

questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

The risky character of his artistic strategy (criticize) by the Viennese elite and local Salzburg shopkeepers. (3단어)

det.korean: criticize(동사원형) → is being criticized: 현재진행형 수동태(지속적으로 비판받는 중)
det.analysis: 주어(character) + is being + 과거분사 → is being criticized

questions.passage: In 1991, the Flemish cultural entrepreneur Gerard Mortier became artistic director of the traditional Salzburger Festspiele in Austria with its mainly conservative content and background. Mozart has always been the most important artist of this world-famous festival. Mortier has been trying to innovate the festival by introducing modern artists like the stage producer and theatre maker Peter Sellars, singer David Bowie and film-maker Peter Greenaway. Mortier bases his programme on four categories: 1. Mozart's music, 2. classical music of the 20th century, 3. new music theatre events by modern artists, 4. a mixture of film and pop music culture. This programme is motivated by the __________ and critical discussion about societal phenomena such as pop music and spirituality. The risky character of his artistic strategy is constantly being criticized by the Viennese elite and local Salzburg shopkeepers. However, fundamentally Mortier knows exactly how to retain the balance between tradition and innovation, which guarantees the continuity of this festival.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: need for a young audience(젊은 관객의 필요성) — 새로운 프로그램의 동기, 'critical discussion' 함께 거론
det.analysis:
✅ ① need for a young audience: 원문 일치, 혁신의 동기
❌ ② conservative content and background: 축제의 기존 배경이지 프로그램의 동기 아님
❌ ③ risky character of his artistic strategy: 결과적 평가이지 동기 아님
❌ ④ continuity of this festival: 결론 효과이지 출발점 동기 아님
det.tip: motivated by the need for a young audience

ch: risky character of his artistic strategy
